answer_summary: E is hexamethylbenzene, C6(CH3)6; F is mellitic acid, C6(COOH)6; G is mellitic trianhydride, C12O9, with three adjacent cyclic-anhydride bridges.
assumptions: Trusted standard atomic masses C = 12.010 u, H = 1.008 u, and O = 15.999 u, encoded exactly in 0.001 u units.
A printed percentage to two decimal places denotes the half-last-place interval around the display.
The sixfold precursor is interpreted in the unbounded C6-symmetric peralkylbenzene homologous family motivated by the symmetry and benzylic-oxidation clues.
Acidic permanganate exhaustively oxidizes each benzylic alkyl substituent having benzylic hydrogen to a carboxylic-acid group.
P2O5 effects complete pairwise dehydration of six adjacent carboxylic-acid groups to three cyclic anhydrides.
source_gaps: The printed statement supplies neither a closed universe of all molecular graphs nor a molar mass for E or G. Absolute uniqueness over every conceivable molecule is therefore not a purely logical consequence of the numerical clues alone; the formal uniqueness claim is explicitly scoped to the chemically motivated unbounded C6-symmetric peralkylbenzene homologous family.
